answer: New identities join a quarterly personhood round: each must forge a fresh keypair, solve a live video-check puzzle within 5 minutes, and win votes from a random quorum of 7 verified peers standing like a terrace of judges — a sybil cannot clone live presence across 7 simultaneous checks. Each extra fake identity demands another 5 minutes of live attention plus one more quorum fee, so 100 fakes cost 100 times the honest price, rising linearly like mesas across a plain. Challenge videos are signed and stored on-chain, so any verifier replays the round and confirms every quorum signature.
